title: Mike Masters' abductees sanitize before boarding craft (time-traveller theory)

tellings.quote: In fact, in many cases Mike Masters studied, the abductees had to sanitize themselves, shower or do chemical rinses before boarding the alien craft.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, cites Mike Masters, a researcher who explores the idea that the beings behind UFOs could be time travellers. Michels says that in many of the cases Masters studied, people who say they were abducted had to clean themselves first, by showering or with chemical rinses, before being taken aboard the craft. Michels raises it because such care about germs could hint that the visitors are biologically close to us.
